historical_sources.scope: Local Unity Time Library context; no publication to Google Slides or digital book.
historical_sources.historical_fidelity: Artistic reconstructions and explicit philosophical allegories. No image claims a documented biographical event. Native titles only; no fabricated quotations.

sources.title: Πλάτων · Φαίδων
sources.basis: Forms, soul, recollection and affinity with the intelligible. Visual symbolism is illustrative.

sources.title: Πλάτων · Μένων
sources.basis: Geometrical inquiry and recollection; Academy activity is an imagined period reconstruction, not a literal event in the Meno.

sources.title: Αριστοτέλης · Αναλυτικά Πρότερα
sources.basis: Terms, premises and deduction. The image of grouping is an introductory visual metaphor, not a full syllogistic diagram.

sources.title: Αριστοτέλης · Φυσικά Γ΄
sources.basis: Motion/change in relation to potentiality and actuality.

sources.title: Αριστοτέλης · Μετά τα Φυσικά Λ΄
sources.basis: Unmoved mover as final cause; avoid a temporal first push or a body moving the cosmos.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy · Stoicism
sources.basis: Zeno and the Painted Stoa; immanent active Logos/creative fire; virtue, reason and nature.

sources.title: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy · Plotinus
sources.basis: One, Intellect, Soul; timeless ontological dependence rather than liquid, material splitting or chronological creation.

sources.title: ASCSA · The Pnyx in Athens
sources.basis: Early Pnyx assembly setting; avoid importing the late-4th-century monumental phase into Pericles' time.

sources.title: ASCSA · Athenian Agora excavations
sources.basis: Civic and everyday activities in the Classical Agora and its surrounding houses/workshops.

sources.title: Acropolis Museum · Sanctuary and Theatre of Dionysos
sources.basis: Theater on the south slope of the Acropolis.

sources.title: ASCSA · Theater seating research
sources.basis: Distinguish the early wooden theater from late-4th-century stone seating.

sources.title: Ιωάννης 13
sources.basis: Washing the disciples' feet: personal self-giving love.

sources.title: Existing lesson_logos_concept_map.json
sources.basis: User's teaching bridge from philosophical language to Christian personal Logos; not an equation between emanation and creation.
